user.title: Device Maintenance
user.description: Create a new maintenance tracker or import a compatible legacy tracker.

create.title: Add maintenance tracker
create.description: Choose a name and how the interval should be measured.

maintenance_item.title: What is maintained or replaced?
maintenance_item.description: Describe the maintenance/replacement item itself. A battery percentage sensor is separate and selected later. You can link the tracker to a physical Home Assistant device and, when needed, give multiple trackers the same UI group so they are shown as one card.

data.linked_entity: Link to physical device through entity (optional)

battery_details.title: Replaceable battery
battery_details.description: Enter how many batteries are replaced together and which battery type is used.

item_details.title: Replacement item
item_details.description: Enter the quantity and, when useful, a type/model/specification for the filter, cartridge, blade, or other item.

legacy_import.title: Import legacy tracker
legacy_import.description: Choose a compatible elapsed tracker. The legacy configuration is left untouched.

legacy_preview.title: Preview import

session_runtime.title: Session runtime
session_runtime.description: Accumulate positive changes from a sensor that reports runtime for the current session.

elapsed.title: Elapsed time
elapsed.description: Track wall-clock time between maintenance actions.

initial_action.title: Last maintenance action
initial_action.description: Choose when the current maintenance cycle started. Use Now if the action was just performed, or enter an earlier date/time if the device has already been in use for a while.

initial_action_datetime.title: Enter last maintenance action
initial_action_datetime.description: Choose the date and time of the last charge, replacement, or maintenance action. The value is stored internally in UTC and displayed using Home Assistant's timezone.

abort.no_legacy_trackers: No compatible legacy elapsed trackers were found.
abort.already_configured: This legacy tracker has already been imported.
abort.legacy_tracker_unavailable: The legacy tracker is no longer available.

error.legacy_tracker_unavailable: The legacy tracker is no longer available.
error.invalid_initial_action: The date/time could not be parsed.
error.future_initial_action: The last maintenance action cannot be in the future.

init.title: Device Maintenance settings
init.description: Metadata can be edited without resetting learned history. Give trackers the same UI group to show them together in the dynamic card. The picture key is the filename without extension in the card's pictures directory.

data.linked_entity: Link to physical device through entity
